t: Why you should visit the Danish island of Fyn
s: Are you looking to slow things down for a bit? To disconnect from the hustle and bustle? If so, we heartily recommend a few days on the island of Fyn. First off, it’s pretty. It’s the green heartbeat of Denmark, covered in gardens, woods and parks. Fyn is connected to lots of smaller islands around its southern shores, so you can use it as a jump off to a little island-hopping adventure all your own.
